module: Transforms what an editor has just built in the world into what a site manifest carries. A site is designed at one place on the map and placed elsewhere: all bakes therefore subtract their origin (ox, oy, oz) from everything before writing (geometry, kit transforms, lamps, plantings, ground plan). The chosen origin matters little to the placer (it realigns on the bounds read) but must be the SAME for all lists of a manifest. Plan coordinates are rounded to the millimeter.
notes: A ground "plan" is made of {x,y} polygons or polylines; a terraform "feature" is either a graded QUAD (4 corners with their heights), or RINGS at a common height; default mode 'carve'.
The feature rings come out flat (a single z per feature); the reader must rebuild them as vec3.

groupInstances groups by shape + color (glow) + street flag (piece placed on the sidewalk) + stand (post on the ground line, height stretched by the placer). Each instance takes 12 numbers in xf: position (3), forward axis (3), up axis (3), scale (3).
Lamps come out { x, y, z, r (radius), b (brightness), col, street } and, for a spotlight, dir and cone.
localPaint requires extensions.editor_terrainEditor.getTerrainBlock() to exist, and names the paint layers by name (an index is only valid for a single terrain).
Plants travel as anchors (items already scattered, or points + species + an already computed seed) because the forest belongs to the level and not to the site.

localRing.desc: A plan polygon, local to the bake origin, rounded to the millimeter. Returns nil if fewer than 3 points, so that a caller can collect the return directly into a list.

localPts.desc: A polyline in the same way (no minimum number of points). Also used for unit normals with a null origin.

localRings.desc: A list of local rings; nil if none was a polygon (a key absent from the manifest means "this site has none").

localFeatures.desc: The shapes the site asks the ground to be carved to, in its frame. Each feature becomes { quad = 4 corners {local x,y,z}, mode, band } or { rings, z, mode, band }. Ignores what the feature is used for (landing, ramp, retaining wall).

features.desc: List of features { quad } or { rings, z }, with mode ('carve' by default) and band.

returns.desc: List of local features, nil if there are none.

localPaint.desc: The terrain paint a site lays, in its frame. Each layer { m, ring } or { m, xs, ys } (cell by cell) comes out named by terrain material layer.

coats.desc: List of layers: m = material index, ring or xs/ys.

returns.desc: List { layer, ring } or { layer, cells = {x1,y1,x2,y2,...} }; nil if no terrain block or nothing to paint.

groupInstances.desc: Groups the kit's placements by shape. One group per distinct mesh becomes a single instanced draw on arrival: a square with two hundred identical bollards costs one shape and two hundred transforms.

instances.desc: List of instances { shape, px, py, pz, ax, ay, az, ux, uy, uz, scl, glow, street, stand }.

returns.desc: List of groups { shape, xf (12 numbers per instance), glow, street, stand }.

harvestKit.desc: Rereads the frames of kit pieces already placed in the scene and adds them to out as instance records accepted by groupInstances. Accepts either kit entries (obj field) or the objects themselves; vanished objects or those without shapeName are skipped; the night glow (nightEmissive) is reread.

list.desc: List of { obj } entries or scene objects.

returns.desc: Records { shape, glow, px, py, pz, ax.., ux.., scl = {x,y,z} }.

instanceCount.desc: Number of pieces that a list of groups stands up (size of xf divided by 12), for display before writing.

localLamps.desc: The lamps that accompany the pieces, in the site's frame. The color comes from glow or col (white by default). A spotlight (dx present) comes out with dir and cone; a bulb does not.

lights.desc: List of light records { px, py, pz, radius, brightness, glow|col, street, dx, dy, dz, cone }.

returns.desc: List of local lamps, nil if empty.

localPlants.desc: Planting as anchors: { items } for already scattered plants (x, y, sp, s, a), or { points, species, speciesWeights, size, vary, seed, drape, street } for a scatter to redo (the seed is already computed, to obtain the same plants at the same places).

returns.desc: List of local anchors, nil if empty.

plantCount.desc: Number of plants that a bake would carry, over all anchors (items or points). For display only.

bounds.desc: The extent of everything the bake places (part vertices and instance positions, relative to the origin), so that the placer can frame a site, pick it under the cursor and know the room it needs before loading a mesh. Returns two null corners if nothing.
